hypothesis: The fixed passing-yards refit improves on the raw and equal-weight trailing baselines; incremental information beyond the de-vigged market is evaluated separately.

selection.clocks: vendor_updated <= repository_observed < exact_game_kickoff; history_commit and history_generated <= quote_observed; every input game date < target game date
selection.identity: exact unique normalized player name + QB + canonical team among exact scheduled opponents; exact scheduled kickoff and game; public snapshot verified_start games only; exclude incomplete profile windows when ready-model n differs from recoverable start count
selection.prices: both sides present in same row; absolute American odds >=100; proportional de-vig; overround >-.01 and <.25
selection.main_line: choose lowest |mean no-vig over probability-.5| among >=2-book lines when present, otherwise all lines, deterministic smaller-line tie; choose before removing pushes or model missingness
selection.contract: exact NFL game/player/full-game market/line/book; no event-date-only joins
selection.outcomes: public results keyed player/date, unique exact game and player matched separately; missing outcomes excluded, no DNP zero imputation; pushes excluded after main-line selection

fixed_comparators: raw-v1 80/20 lognormal recomputed on identical verified prior starts
equal-weight trailing mean using raw-v1 sigma

splits.status: already previously inspected retrospective reproduction; no untouched holdout or fitting

metrics: logit calibration intercept/slope with constant-prediction diagnostic
median-projection MAE and signed prediction-minus-outcome bias
paired loss differences with 95% NFL-game-cluster bootstrap CI
criteria: Report fixed refit minus baseline paired losses. Improvement requires negative paired Brier and log-loss intervals; market advantage requires same against actual de-vigged prices. No promotion, profit claim, ROI, CLV or execution assumption inferred.
limitations: Historical quote decisions were not selected/frozen prospectively for this independent experiment.
Git commit time is conservative receipt evidence, not provider first availability.
Public profile windows may omit older starter rows after relief appearances; reject incomplete inputs.
Posted quote prices do not establish execution, wager acceptance or stake capacity.
No complete historical game-day availability receipts, hence an informational forecasting cohort rather than actionable betting validation.
